lines: Inner standing Khecarī this called contraction moon-marked; therefore indeed having raised arms and bent.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsthitiḥ khecarīyaṃ saṃkocākhyā śaśāṅkinī tasmādeva samuttambya bāhū caivāvakuñcitau
